transcript: Speaker A: Kaun ho tum? Aur Ayesha ji ko kyun maarne aaye ho? [Who are you? And why have you come to kill Ayesha ji?] Speaker B: Woh main tujhe baad mein batata hoon. Pehle ek baat meri dhyan se sun. Jo mere raste mein aata hai na, uska main bura haal karta hoon. [I'll tell you that later. First, listen to me carefully. Whoever comes in my way, I make their condition miserable.] Speaker C: Jalal ko khatm karna itna aasan nahin hai, Shekhar. Tumse pehle bhi ek agent aaya tha yahan. Kuchh nahin bigaad paya Jalal ka. Ulta Jalal ne hi us agent ko kahin pe band kar diya. 15 saal se woh agent gayab hai. Shekhar, suno. Tum abhi apna focus sirf Ayesha pe rakho. Usi ke zariye tum Jalal tak pahunch paoge. Uske alawa koi rasta nahin hai. Jalal kab kahan hota hai, kab kis roop mein hota hai, yeh... yeh koi nahin jaanta. [It's not that easy to finish Jalal, Shekhar. An agent came here before you too. He couldn't do anything to Jalal. Instead, Jalal locked that agent up somewhere. That agent has been missing for 15 years. Shekhar, listen. For now, keep your focus only on Ayesha. Only through her will you be able to reach Jalal. There is no other way. When and where Jalal is, in what form he is... no one knows.] Speaker A: Waise Jalal aur woh Don Sebastian ke beech jo drug ki deal hone wali thi, uski koi khabar? [By the way, any news about the drug deal that was supposed to happen between Jalal and Don Sebastian?] Speaker C: Maine track kiya hai. Woh deal isi week mein hogi. Don Sebastian khud Mumbai aa raha hai. Yahi mauka hai, Shekhar. Ek teer se do shikaar karne honge. [I have tracked it. That deal will happen this week. Don Sebastian himself is coming to Mumbai. This is the chance, Shekhar. We have to kill two birds with one stone.] Speaker D: Malik. Maaf kar dijiye, malik. Aage se kabhi shikayat ka mauka nahin dunga. Maafi. [Master. Forgive me, master. I won't give you a chance to complain in the future. Forgiveness.] Speaker B: Maafi tumhe tab milegi jab tum us Shekhar ki history nikal ke laoge. Uske ladne ka tareeka ek teacher wala nahin tha. Woh jaisa dikh raha hai, asal mein aisa hai nahin. [You will get forgiveness when you bring me Shekhar's history. His way of fighting was not like a teacher's. He is not what he appears to be.] Speaker E: Jalal ko shak ho gaya. Ab Shekhar ke paas waqt nahin hai. Kya woh mission poora kar payega ya khud bhi 15 saal gayab ho jayega? English Seekho app kholo aur search karke dekho Jasoos Teacher. Aur saath mein wahi English seekho jo Shekhar ko Don ke ghar mein zinda rakhti hai. Aaj hi shuru karo. [Jalal has got suspicious. Now Shekhar has no time. Will he be able to complete the mission or will he also disappear for 15 years? Open the English Seekho app and search for Jasoos Teacher. And along with it, learn the same English that keeps Shekhar alive in the Don's house. Start today.] Speaker F: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
